name: Trailing_Profit
summary: This EA is a trailing profit/stop utility that manages existing open positions by dynamically adjusting stop-loss levels as price moves favorably. It does not open trades on its own but instead trails the profit of positions already opened by the user or another EA.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个移动止盈/止损工具，通过动态调整止损水平来管理已有的持仓。它本身不开仓，而是跟踪用户或其他EA已开仓位的利润变动。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是移动止损（Trailing Stop），即随着价格朝有利方向移动，逐步上移（多单）或下移（空单）止损位以锁定利润。入场条件方面，此EA不自行入场，而是依赖于已有持仓的存在，当持仓浮盈达到设定的启动阈值时开始移动止损。出场条件由移动止损触发——当价格回撤至动态止损位时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已有仓位的风险水平。资金管理方面，通过逐步锁定利润来保护账户资金，防止盈利单变为亏损单。该EA适用于趋势行情中保护已有利润，但在震荡行情中可能因价格频繁回撤而过早平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is the trailing stop mechanism, which gradually moves the stop-loss level upward for long positions or downward for short positions as price moves favorably to lock in profit. Regarding entry conditions, this EA does not open trades on its own; it begins trailing once an existing position's floating profit reaches a configurable activation threshold. Exit conditions are triggered when price retraces to the dynamically adjusted stop-loss level, closing the position. Position sizing is not handled by this EA as it only manages existing positions without opening new ones. Money management is achieved by progressively locking in profits to protect account equity from turning winning trades into losing ones. This EA is well-suited for trending markets to protect accumulated gains but may cause premature exits in choppy or ranging markets due to frequent price retracements.

parameters.name: TrailingStart
parameters.description: 移动止损启动点数阈值，浮盈达到此值后开始跟踪
parameters.description_en: 移动止损启动点数阈值，浮盈达到此值后开始跟踪

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损跟踪距离点数，止损与当前价格的间距
parameters.description_en: 移动止损跟踪距离点数，止损与当前价格的间距

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 移动止损最小步进点数，止损每次调整的最小幅度
parameters.description_en: 移动止损最小步进点数，止损每次调整的最小幅度

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术号码，用于标识需管理的仓位，0表示管理所有仓位
parameters.description_en: 魔术号码，用于标识需管理的仓位，0表示管理所有仓位

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否应用于所有交易品种，false则仅管理当前图表品种
parameters.description_en: 是否应用于所有交易品种，false则仅管理当前图表品种

pros: 自动化利润保护机制，有效防止盈利单回吐为亏损
参数灵活可调，可根据不同品种和市场波动性自定义跟踪参数
支持魔术号筛选，可配合其他EA使用而不产生冲突
操作简单，无需人工干预即可持续管理持仓风险
pros_en: Automated profit protection mechanism that effectively prevents winning trades from turning into losses
Flexible and adjustable parameters allowing customization based on different instruments and market volatility
Supports magic number filtering for compatibility with other EAs without conflicts
Simple operation with continuous risk management of positions without manual intervention
cons: 在震荡行情中可能因价格频繁回撤而过早触发止损导致利润缩水
不自行开仓，依赖其他策略或手动操作提供初始仓位
缺乏波动率自适应机制，固定点数跟踪在不同波动环境下表现不一
未考虑点差和手续费对实际利润的影响，可能导致实际收益低于预期
cons_en: May trigger stops prematurely in choppy markets due to frequent price retracements, reducing potential profit
Does not open positions independently, relying on other strategies or manual trading for initial entries
Lacks volatility-adaptive mechanism, fixed pip trailing performs inconsistently across varying volatility environments
Does not account for spread and commission impacts on actual profit, potentially leading to lower-than-expected returns
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态跟踪距离，使移动止损能适应不同波动率环境
加入部分平仓功能，当利润达到一定水平时先锁定部分利润再继续跟踪
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic trailing distance to adapt the trailing stop to different volatility environments
Implement partial close functionality to lock in a portion of profits at certain levels before continuing to trail

risk_points: 固定点数跟踪在低波动品种上可能过于紧密导致过早平仓
缺乏对极端行情（跳空）的专门处理机制
risk_points_en: Fixed pip trailing may be too tight on low-volatility instruments causing premature exits
Lacks specialized handling for extreme market conditions such as price gaps
